map_dots_explanation:
Each dot stands for {n} votes, coloured by party.
Dots are placed at random within their municipality – they show how many people voted where, not where they live.
map_change_no_compare_wb: Polling districts change between elections – no comparison possible
map_change_explanation:
Change since {year}, in percentage points.
Plus: higher than in {year}. Minus: lower.
No colour: no comparison possible, e.g. because results for one of the two years are missing.
map_change_explanation_winner:
Shows where the {metric} changed since {year}.
Striped: changed – pale is the {year} party, strong the new one. Pale area: the same party as in {year}.
No colour: no comparison possible.
map_split_explanation:
Compares the first votes for a party's direct candidate with the party's second votes.
Plus: the candidate gets more votes than the party, attracting voters from elsewhere.
Minus: some of the party's voters give their first vote to someone else.
map_popup_keine_wahl: Unincorporated area – no elections are held here
map_values_switch_label: Values as share or vote count
map_hover_keine_wahl: Unincorporated area – no elections are held here.
map_hover_keine_kreistagswahl: Cities exempt from a county – no county-council election is held here.
map_hover_keine_daten: No data for this election in this region.
map_panel_footnote_drill: Click a region on the map to go one level deeper.
map_panel_missing_note: No results for {missing} of {total} municipalities in this area — the figures are incomplete.
map_mandate_no_seat_note: Not covered by second votes: the {party} won more constituencies in Baden-Württemberg than its second votes entitle it to seats — this constituency has no directly elected member of the Bundestag.
map_mandate_source_landtag: Source: Landeszentrale für politische Bildung Baden-Württemberg, based on the Statistisches Landesamt
map_panel_postal_elsewhere_note: This municipality's postal votes are counted centrally and aren't included here — turnout and shares cover in-person voting only.
map_panel_stuttgart_urn_only_note: Stuttgart 2019: there is no assignment of postal votes to the individual polling districts — their figures cover in-person voting only, so turnout looks too low.
map_panel_postal_estimated_note: Postal votes aren’t counted per polling district: each postal district is spread over the polling districts it serves here (by their number of voters with a postal-vote certificate) — so the per-district figures are estimates.
map_panel_postal_estimated_note_stuttgar: Stuttgart: every polling district has its own postal district, whose votes are fully included here. Only the centrally counted postal votes (“Schwabenzentrum”, about 3 % of postal votes) are spread over the polling districts of their Stadtbezirk (by voters with a postal-vote certificate).
map_panel_candidates_none: No results for individual candidates available.
map_panel_joint_list_note: Joint lists of several parties (e.g. "CDU/FWV") are counted for each party involved — so the shares add up to more than 100 %.

about_intro: This project grew out of the master's thesis “Do names matter in local elections?” in International Business and Economics at the University of Hohenheim, submitted in 2025.
about_thesis: The thesis examines whether characteristics voters infer from a candidate's name – such as gender, age or origin – affect how many votes they receive in local elections in Baden-Württemberg. For this, the results of every municipality were collected down to the level of individual polling districts.
about_dashboard: The map on this website grew out of that data collection: it makes the results of local, state, federal and European elections in Baden-Württemberg freely accessible and comparable.
about_disclaimer: This is not an official service. All information without guarantee; the official final results of the respective election authorities are authoritative.
about_src_kommone: Results of the municipalities and districts that publish through Komm.ONE's portal (votemanager), including its open-data exports.
about_src_statistik_ltw: Results of the 2026 state election down to polling-district level, elected members and candidates per constituency.
about_src_bundeswahlleiterin: Constituency results and elected members of federal elections; assignment of municipalities to the 2025 federal constituencies.
about_src_bundestag: Master data of the members of the German Bundestag.
about_src_lpb: Members by constituency for state elections up to 2021.
about_src_osm: Boundaries of administrative regions, districts and municipalities, federal constituencies, and the background map.
about_src_statistik_wk: State constituencies and the assignment of municipalities to them.
about_src_stuttgart: Stuttgart's polling districts and their assignment to postal-vote districts.
about_src_kommone_geo: Polling-district boundaries of the cities that publish them for the 2026 state election.
about_src_zensus: Municipalities and population figures (Census 2022, table 1000A-0000, as of 15.05.2022).
about_src_destatis: Assignment of municipalities to the 2021 federal constituencies (municipality register GV-ISys, Q4 2020).
about_src_parties: Grouping parties into party families and their colours are this project's own choices.

datenschutz_controller: The controller responsible for data processing on this website within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:
datenschutz_overview: This website has no user accounts, advertising, analytics or tracking. Visitors' personal data is processed only as far as technically necessary to deliver the website, as described below.
datenschutz_hosting: The website is operated by the controller themselves; no hosting provider is involved. On every request, the server processes the IP address, date and time, the requested address, the previously visited page (referrer), and browser and operating system. This data is needed to deliver the website and keep it secure (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Server log files are deleted after {days} days at the latest.
datenschutz_cookies: The website only sets technically necessary cookies (§ 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG):
datenschutz_cookie_locale: “PARAGLIDE_LOCALE” stores the chosen language so it is kept on your next visit (stored for about 400 days).
datenschutz_osm: The background map is loaded from servers of the OpenStreetMap Foundation (St John’s Innovation Centre, Cowley Road, Cambridge, CB4 0WS, United Kingdom). This transmits your IP address and information about your browser to the OpenStreetMap Foundation. The background map is needed for the website's core function: only with it can the election results be placed geographically. The legal basis is therefore the legitimate interest in presenting the results comprehensibly (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). The EU Commission has issued an adequacy decision for the United Kingdom (Art. 45 GDPR).
datenschutz_osm_link: Privacy policy of the OpenStreetMap Foundation
datenschutz_fonts: The fonts used are served from this server. There is no connection to Google or any other font provider.
datenschutz_email: If you get in touch by email, your details are processed to handle your request (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and deleted once it is dealt with, unless legal retention obligations apply.
datenschutz_candidates_title: Names of candidates and elected members
datenschutz_candidates: The website shows names of candidates and elected members as publicly announced by election authorities and municipalities (see the data sources on the About page). This processing serves the transparency and traceability of election results (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Data subjects may object to the processing on grounds relating to their particular situation (Art. 21 GDPR).
datenschutz_rights: You have the right of access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21). To exercise them, contact the email address above.
datenschutz_complaint: You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR), for example the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of Baden-Württemberg.
